You have been accommodating, and that matters. But I can't tell you something I don't believe just because it's easier. If your project plan is solid, I'll say so. If it isn't, I owe you the truth. What I won't do is pretend. You've earned my respect, not my silence.

If you want, I'm happy to look at the plan with you and tell you what I actually see — the good and the gaps. That's the kind of honesty I think you're asking for, and it's what I can give.
